message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta.  
Here’s how:

| Method | What to do | Contact info |
|--------|------------|--------------|
| **Online** | Visit the City’s 311 portal at <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> and select “Noise” under “Report a Problem.” | – |
| **Phone** | Call the 311 hotline (or the police non‑emergency line) at **404‑656‑4000** and request to file a noise complaint. | 404‑656‑4000 |
| **Email** | Send a brief description of the issue to **noise@atlanta.ga.us**. Include your name, address, time of disturbance, and any relevant details. | noise@atlanta.ga.us |
| **In‑person** | Go to the City Hall at **100 Peachtree St. NE, Atlanta, GA 30303** and speak with the Public Works or Police Department staff. | 100 Peachtree St. NE, Atlanta, GA 30303 |

**What to include in your complaint**

1. Your full name and contact information.  
2. Exact address or intersection where the noise originates.  
3. Time(s) and dates of the disturbance.  
4. Description of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs).  
5. Any evidence you have (photos, videos, audio recordings).  

After filing, the City will log your complaint and dispatch the appropriate department (often the Police Department or the Department of Environmental Protection) to investigate. You’ll receive a reference number; keep it handy for follow‑up.

If you’re dealing with a recurring problem, consider following up after a few days or weeks to check on the status of the investigation.
